reviewed: Original scan pp.108--109; Eqs2.14,3.2--3.6 and Figure1 visually inspected.
scope: One-dimensional isobaric reduction in Lagrangian mass coordinates; positive state-dependent mobility and a Lyapunov functional. Not a full compressible-gas gradient-flow claim.
own_derivation: The theta=int kappa dT static transformation is explicitly our derivation from the static energy equation. No numerical dynamics or speed validation added.
source_distinction: The paper distinguishes its general cooling function from the earlier cubic model of Elphick, Regev & Spiegel1991. Do not imply all cooling laws in the 1992 paper are cubic.
